title: feat(crm): add console plugin integration, CLI dev mode, and plugin export
body:
Enable `examples/crm` to work as both a standalone debuggable app (via CLI) and a reusable plugin for other projects.

### CLI Development Modes

- **`pnpm dev`** — `objectstack serve --dev` with auto MemoryDriver, Studio UI, and ConsolePlugin
- **`pnpm serve`** — production mode via CLI, ConsolePlugin loaded from config
- **`pnpm start`** — custom `tsx server.ts` with explicit auth, logging, full control

### Console Integration

`ConsolePlugin` added to `objectstack.config.ts` plugins array so the CLI `serve` command loads the Console UI automatically — no custom server.ts needed for basic usage.

### Plugin Export

New `plugin.ts` with `CRMPlugin` class and `crmConfig` raw export, exposed via `./plugin` package export:

```ts
// As a kernel plugin
import { CRMPlugin } from '@object-ui/example-crm/plugin';
kernel.use(new CRMPlugin());

// For config merging
import { crmConfig } from '@object-ui/example-crm/plugin';
```

### Changes

- `objectstack.config.ts` — embed `ConsolePlugin` in `plugins` array (uses `as any` since `defineStack` schema doesn't include runtime plugins, consistent with `objectstack.shared.ts`)
- `package.json` — add `dev` script, `type: module`, `./plugin` export path
- `plugin.ts` — new `CRMPlugin` class wrapping CRM metadata as kernel-compatible plugin
- `server.ts` — import `ConsolePlugin` directly from `@object-ui/console`
- `tsconfig.json` — include `plugin.ts`
